#id: # NCS layer format (AIA CAD Layer Guidelines): discipline designator (2),
# major group (4), up to two minor groups (4), status (1, last field).
# Layer names, colours (RGB), line widths and line styles from the A/E/C
# CAD Standard Release 6.0 (ERDC/ITL TR-12-6, public), which follows the
# NCS format. "derived" in the note: no verbatim A/E/C layer; built from
# the format with the pen of the named A/E/C layer. Named line styles
# with text or symbols are drawn CONTINUOUS. See docs/laagstandaarden.md.
